idea.title: Competitor price tracker — I check 6 sites manually every week, need automation

plan.tagline: Automates competitor price tracking across multiple sites
plan.problem: Manually checking competitor prices on multiple sites is time-consuming and prone to errors
plan.solution: PricePulse automates the process by crawling specified sites, storing prices in a local database, generating reports, and sending alerts for price changes
plan.target_market: Indie hackers, developers, and small businesses worldwide

build_phases.name: Core DB + add
build_phases.description: Design sqlite schema and implement add/list commands

build_phases.name: Reports + alerts
build_phases.description: Implement report generation and notification system

build_phases.name: Demo + polish
build_phases.description: Implement --demo mode, --help, and edge case handling

plan.demo_script: Runs a simulated price tracking scenario with hardcoded data, demonstrating report generation and alert notifications
plan.phuket_angle: Helps Phuket-based tourism businesses track competitor pricing for services like snorkeling tours or hotel bookings
